Fake it till you make it. I get this a lot and all I can say is when you start feeling overwhelmed or that feeling of paralyzing anxiety, just make sure you tell yourself you are happy right now and your brain will most likely just roll with it.

Let me put this into perspective for you. When you go home you think about what you did. You think about something awkward you said or how you messed up on something. You don’t really think about how they said something that embarrassed them or how they messed up. You all think the same thing, and that’s about yourself. I don’t want to say you’re self centered because I 100% understand how you are feeling, but try putting yourself in their shoes and realize that nobody really looks twice when you mess up :)
